1.name: Zadar Airport (ZAD) — car pickup Jun 16 10:00
1.note: Flight lands Jun 16 09:00; ~45-60min bags + rental desk; car pickup 10:00. ⚠ EES (live Apr 2026): if ANY of the 4 hold NON-EU passports, budget extra time at arrival for biometric enrolment (and on D12 cross ME->HR before ~09:00 / after ~15:00 — Karasovici 2-5h at midday peak). All-EU/EEA = fast lane, ignore.

1.name: Krka National Park (Skradinski Buk)
1.note: Inland ~77km but on the Zadar->Split line. Swimming BANNED at Skradinski Buk since 2021 (walk/photo only). Tickets ONLINE-ONLY timed entry (shop.np-krka.hr) — EUR40pp June, BUT after 15:00 = EUR30pp (a tired late arrival hits this window). The Skradin<->falls boat is INCLUDED in the ticket (Apr-Oct) — legal swim = Skradin town beach. THE skip candidate if arrival-day energy is low.

1.name: Skradin town beach (Krka swim alternative)
1.note: D1 HIGHLIGHT — the legal Krka swim: NP shuttle boat down from Skradinski Buk to Skradin town beach (~hourly, last boats early evening). Confirm the boat is running the day you go; if you walked in from the Skradin entrance you're already in town and need no boat.

1.name: Kantun Paulina (Split ćevapi institution)
1.note: Day 1 (Jun 16) — quick cevapi stop in Split en route Krka -> Krvavica. Off-peak (before 12:00 or after 14:00) skips the worst queue; you'll likely hit it ~16:00-16:30 which is fine.
1.bestTime: Day 2 (Jun 17) — quick ćevapi stop in Split en route Paklenica → Omiš. Off-peak (before 12:00 or after 14:00) to skip the worst of the queue.

1.name: Camping Krvavica
1.note: Arrival-night base ~10km W of Makarska; pitch ~18:00 with daylight. Pricing ~EUR12 adult + ~EUR8 tent + ~EUR4.50 car (+EUR3-5 electricity) = ~EUR55-65 for 4. Ramova/own beach is a 2-3min walk — arrival swim then camp-cook dinner.

2.name: Biokovo NP scenic toll road (booking + drive)
2.note: ⚠ VERIFY FIRST: a SPECIAL TRAFFIC REGULATION (fire-restoration) closes the Biokovo road to cars on WEEKDAYS ~07:00-15:00, in effect until Jun 19 2026. D2 is Wed Jun 17 = a weekday, so a dawn ~06:30 slot likely can't summit + descend (blocked/stuck until 15:00). CALL info@pp-biokovo.hr / +385 21 616 924 to confirm Jun 17 car access BEFORE relying on it — the booking page can stay open under a closure. If blocked: lead D2 with the Cetina canyoning anchor; do Biokovo only if access is confirmed (or after 15:00, tight).
2.bestTime: BOOK Jun 18 morning slot now at shop.pp-biokovo.hr — capped at 20 cars/hour; sells out in June. Open 06:00–20:00.

2.name: Sveti Jure (Biokovo summit, 1762m)
2.note: Conditional on the Biokovo road being open to cars on Jun 17 (see the toll-road warning: weekday 07:00-15:00 closure until Jun 19 2026). If confirmed open, summit early for the haze-free panorama; if not, skip — Cetina canyoning carries D2. ~150min if it runs.
2.bestTime: Day 3 (Jun 18) early — leave Makarska 07:00, summit before 09:00 (the Skywalk slot is booked at shop.pp-biokovo.hr, 20-car/hour cap). Clear morning essential for the 360° Adriatic + island view.

2.name: Cetina Canyoning (Zadvarje / Gubavica)
2.note: D2 ★ ANCHOR (carries the day regardless of the Biokovo road closure). Book a slot 1-2 days ahead (canyoning-cetina.com ~EUR70pp Extreme 18+ / maldukadventures.com). Shaded cold canyon = ideal midday-heat block; 12m jumps + 55m waterfall rappel. ~3h.
2.bestTime: Day 2 (Jun 17) — book 1–2 days ahead at canyoning-cetina.com (~€70pp) or maldukadventures.com. June = good water. Extreme tour is 18+.

2.name: Konoba Feral (Brela — peka & seafood)
2.note: The ONE Riviera peka (the day's special meal) — best-rated Brela konoba, 10m from the beach, no Omiš backtrack. Pre-order octopus/veal peka in the morning. Replaces Konoba Gušti.
2.bestTime: June reality: reserve ~3 days ahead (phone only), walk-ins wait ~30 min; peka still pre-order; sunset for the beachfront table

2.name: Makarska (Deep cave club + Osejava cliffs)
2.note: OPTIONAL late night ~23:00-02:00 — Deep cave club + Osejava cliff walk. Only if NOT doing the early canyoning AND remembering Jun 18 (Day 3) is the FIXED Dubrovnik-airport pickup with a long drive. The obvious drop-if-tired stop.

3.name: Baćina lakes (Baćinska jezera)
3.bestTime: afternoon swim break on the drive south

3.name: Pelješac Bridge (Dubrovnik approach)
3.bestTime: Day 3 (Jun 18) en route Makarska → Dubrovnik — you just drive over it

3.name: Walls of Ston (Pelješac)
3.note: D3 ★ — FIRST activity of the morning, gates open 08:00, walk 08:30-10:00. No shade, white limestone, real climb: do it before June midday heat and tour buses. ~EUR10pp. Do the shorter Ston->Mali Ston traverse (~45-60min) to stay on schedule for the ferry.

3.name: Mali Ston oysters
3.note: Quick-grab on the airport/ferry day: shuck-and-go at the Mali Ston / Bistrina roadside farm stalls (~EUR1/oyster, cash, ~09:00-16:00). Do NOT sit down at Bota Sare (opens 12:00 = burns ferry-critical time). 20-30min stop.
3.bestTime: Day 3 (Jun 18) lunch stop en route Split→Dubrovnik. Bota Šare opens 12:00 — call ahead: +385 20 754482. Off-peak = quicker service.

3.name: Dubrovnik Airport (Čilipi) — Jun 18 friend pickup
3.note: BOOK: Be parked by ~17:10; expect to actually roll out ~17:45-18:00. Leave Pelješac by ~15:45 to absorb June …
3.bestTime: Day 3 (Jun 18) — leave Makarska by 13:00–13:30 latest. Flight lands 17:20; plan to be at arrivals by 17:30. Drive Makarska→DBV is ~2.5h without stops.

3.name: Prapratno ferry port (→ Mljet)
3.note: #1 SPOF. DBV airport -> Prapratno is ~1h15 (budget 1h30 for June traffic). On-time 17:20 landing -> rolling ~17:45 -> Prapratno ~19:30 for the 20:30 LAST sailing (queue >=45min, cars first-come). PLAN B: pre-buy the ticket ONLINE; if not clearing arrivals by ~17:50, SKIP the 20:30 and sleep mainland (Autocamp Prapratno/near Ston), take the 06:00/10:15 ferry D4 AM.
3.bestTime: D3 (Thu Jun 18) EVENING — the trip's #1 fragility. Friend lands DBV 17:20; pickup, then ~1h45–2h drive DBV→Prapratno (via Dubrovnik+Ston) = arrive ~19:30–19:45 for the 20:30 LAST sailing. June 2026 Prapratno→Sobra (29 May–2 Jul block): 07:00, 10:15, 13:00, 17:00, 20:30 (verified Jun 2026). Cars first-come, no reservation, ~50/boat — be in the queue ≥45 min early. Pre-buy tickets online to skip the desk. Plan B if flight delayed past ~18:30: sleep mainland near Ston/Slano, take 07:00 or 10:15 ferry next morning.

3.name: Autokamp Mungos (Babino Polje, Mljet)
3.note: Night-arrival-safe Mljet camp by the Sobra ferry (pool, restaurant, mini-market) - pitch within minutes of the 20:30 ferry landing ~21:15. (Autokamp Marina/Ropa kept as the NP-side alternative.)

4.name: Odysseus Cave (Mljet, cliff-jump swim)
4.note: Quick dawn cliff-jump/swim ~1.3km from the Mungos camp (~07:30) — do this OR the salt-lakes kayak, NOT a leisurely both, or you miss the 12:00 Sobra ferry. Free, no ticket. Kayak is the stronger single pick.
4.bestTime: Day 4 (Jun 19) morning — first stop after the Sobra ferry (~10 min drive). Go 09:00–11:00 for best cave light. Outside cliff platforms open all day for cliff jumping.

4.name: Self-rent kayak / SUP on the Mljet salt lakes (Mali Most & Pomena)
4.note: D4 ★ — self-rent kayak/SUP across the emerald salt lakes to St Mary islet. Arrange rental the NIGHT BEFORE for an ~08:00-08:30 start; NP entry ~EUR25pp. MUST be back near Sobra to queue for the 12:00 ferry by ~10:45 — this is the activity you SHORTEN if tight, never the ferry. Then ferry 12:00 -> drive ~2h -> Kravica.

4.name: Kravica Waterfalls
4.note: Cash-only (KM): entry ~20 KM/pp + parking. Bosnia = cash country — withdraw KM at the FIRST Bosnia ATM after the border (Capljina/Mostar Raiffeisen, no fee). Go before ~10:00 — jammed by tour buses by mid-morning; swimming under the falls allowed.
4.bestTime: Day 5 (Jun 20) — arrive 07:00–08:00 to beat the crowds. June pool swimmable (~18–20°C). Tour buses pack in from ~10:30.

4.name: Počitelj
4.note: Day 4 (Fri Jun 19) — late-afternoon stop ~17:00-17:30 between Kravica and the Poplat bed, kept short (45-50min). Bare stone hill, little shade; late afternoon is fine as heat eases. Free (small tower fee). Pomegranate/fig stalls at the base for a 5-min quick-grab.
4.bestTime: Day 5 (Jun 20) mid-morning — leave Kravica 09:00, arrive Počitelj 09:30. Free (small tower fee €1-2). Combine with Kravica 07:00 early swim and arrive Mostar by 11:00. Midday heat on the stone hill can be brutal — early is better.

5.name: Blagaj Tekija
5.note: Day 5 (Jun 20) — midday stop ~13:00-15:00 after the cool-morning Mostar block (12km south, ~15min). Arrive before 10:00 or after 15:00 to miss tour buses. 10 KM/EUR5 cash; cover knees/shoulders (wraps at door). 1.5h max.
5.bestTime: Day 6 (Jun 21) — midday stop between Kravica and Mostar (12 km south of Mostar, directly on route). Arrive 10:00–11:30 or after 15:00 to miss tour buses. Park at lower lots; cover knees/shoulders (wraps at door). Time: 1.5h max.

5.name: Stari Most Bridge Jump (Mostari Diving Club)
5.note: Do it FIRST at the bridge (~09:00, cool + empty) via the Mostari Divers Club + their mandatory training jump. ~24m — real commitment, decide PER PERSON on the day. Budget ~EUR30-50pp TOTAL (training ~EUR10-25 + the jump ~EUR20-25), cash. Non-jumpers watch from the Halebija/jumpers' viewpoint.

5.name: Mostar (Stari Most)
5.note: Day 5 (Jun 20) — do Mostar in the COOL MORNING ~09:30-10:30; Stari Most is empty and the bridge/jumpers are cool then. Midday = mobbed + 35C. The morning is the move.
5.bestTime: Day 5 (Jun 20) — arrive late afternoon from Kravica falls. Evening and morning are the magic hours — Stari Most glows amber at sunset (~20:25).

5.name: Tima-Irma (Mostar ćevapi institution)
5.note: Day 5 — quick cevapi straight off the bridge in the cool morning, before 12:00 to beat the queue.
5.bestTime: Day 5 (Jun 20) lunch — arrive before 12:00 or after 15:00. No reservation needed, walk-up only. Steps from the Old Bridge.

5.name: Buna River Swimming @ Blagaj
5.note: Day 5 — icy karst-spring swim (~10-12C) on shaded terraces = the day's ideal MIDDAY heat-relief (~13:30), right after the Buna trout lunch.
5.bestTime: early or late to dodge Tekija crowds

5.name: Blagaj Buna-spring trout terraces (Vrelo & neighbours)
5.note: SPECIAL meal: order at RESTORAN VRELO (terrace over the Buna spring, 4.0★) — NOT the cheaper Fajic/Hladovina next door (2.8-3.1★, undercooked + slow). ~EUR9-10/trout, walk-in, a normal ~1h lunch. Midday heat-relief block with the Buna swim.
5.bestTime: Lunch after visiting the Tekija; riverside tables fill up midday

5.name: Fortica Hill — Skywalk & Zipline
5.note: Day 5 (Jun 20) late afternoon ~16:00-18:00 — heat-tolerant exposed hilltop, fits after the Mostar core, before the 21:00 zipline close. Skywalk free; zipline 50 KM/pp. No advance booking but call +387 62 115 100 to confirm open. The day's slack/skip candidate.
5.bestTime: Day 6 (Jun 21) morning — morning for clearest views of Stari Most. Drive 5 km from town. Call +387 62 115 100 ahead to confirm open. Sequence: Kravica 07:00 → Počitelj 09:30 → Fortica 10:30 → Stari Most afternoon.

5.name: Drežnica / Drežanka canyon — local swim canyon
5.note: D5 afternoon water ★ — turquoise pools + local cliff-jump (Stupina) on the paved M17 side road, zero backtrack on the drive N to Ravna. Free, cold glacier-fed water; keep as the on-route afternoon swim.
5.bestTime: Summer for swimming; Veliki Movran waterfall only after heavy rain (not reliable in June)

5.name: Ravna Camping
5.note: BOOK: Arrive ~19:00 with daylight to pitch tents; confirm with the host that arrival after ~18:00 is OK (call…

6.name: Battle of Neretva Museum & sunken bridge (Jablanica)
6.note: Iconic WWII sunken railway bridge + Battle of Neretva museum, right on the M-17 as you leave Ravna/Jablanica - quick on-route stop.
6.bestTime: Daytime; combine with a lamb lunch in Jablanica

6.name: Boračko Lake (swim stop; camp backup)
6.note: Emerald glacial lake ~16km up from Konjic, on the Jablanica->Sarajevo line — swim + self-rent a pedalo or wooden rowboat at the main beach (casual beach-bar rental; SUP sometimes at Eko Selo bar; no formal kayak operator). Morning reset; replaces the wrong-way detour.
6.bestTime: Day 6 (Jun 21) midday swim stop en route Jablanica → Sarajevo (~16 km from Konjic). Emerald glacial lake, perfect break on the long drive day. Or overnight if skipping Sarajevo.

6.name: Buregdžinica ASDŽ (Sarajevo — sač-baked burek)
6.note: ASDZ burek is IN Sarajevo (not roadside) — a late-morning bite once you reach the city, not a Jablanica breakfast. A Jablanica/Konjic lamb or trout stop fits the actual morning drive better.

6.name: Sarajevo (Bascarsija old town)
6.note: D6 ★ (Jun 21, Sunday) — afternoon arrival, evening on foot: Bascarsija at dusk, Zuta Tabija sunset (~20:45), Sunday bar crawl on the Bascarsija cluster (Kino Bosna is CLOSED Sundays). Group SLEEPS in Pale (N6, ~30min SE) — designate a driver for the post-nightlife leg; Pale also pre-positions for Day 7's Foca/Scepan Polje rafting drive.
6.bestTime: Day 6 (Jun 21) — afternoon arrival + overnight. Baščaršija at dusk, Žuta Tabija sunset (20:45), nightlife on Ferhadija. Practical base for Day 7's 08:30 Tara rafting departure.

6.name: Ćevabdžinica Petica Ferhatović (Sarajevo ćevapi)
6.bestTime: Day 6 (Jun 21) lunch — part of the Baščaršija old-town crawl before the Žuta Tabija sunset walk.

6.name: Žuta tabija (Yellow Fortress) — Sarajevo's sunset ritual
6.note: Sarajevo's sunset ritual — sunset Jun 21 is 20:32 (not 20:45). Start the 30-40min uphill walk by ~19:45 to be on the rampart with light to spare. Free.
6.bestTime: Day 6 (Jun 21) sunset — walk up from Baščaršija 30-40 min before sundown (~20:45). Free, bring drinks. Pairs with the Kovači war cemetery below.

6.name: Baščaršija bar cluster (Sunday night out: Barometar, Zlatna Ribica, Cheers, Raya 71)
6.note: Sunday-safe Sarajevo night out (Kino Bosna is closed Sundays). DESIGNATE THE SOBER DRIVER before the crawl — it's a ~40min dark drive back to the Pale bed, then a 07:30 D7 start for the Tara raft. Verify each bar's Sunday hours on the day.

7.name: Tara Canyon rafting — Brštanovica section
7.note: D7 ★ marquee — Tara, Europe's deepest canyon. 2026 price ~EUR70-75pp (~EUR280-300 for 4, cash at camp), full-day incl. lunch + gear + NP fee. Operator shuttle-only, single AM departure — re-confirm before Jun 16 + get the exact meeting point. BOOK NOW (fills weeks ahead).
7.bestTime: Day 7 (Jun 22) — raft Brštanovica → Šćepan Polje (~18km, 3–4h). Book before Jun 16 via email/phone (see Essentials). Late June = high/fast water; wetsuit required (river ~8°C).

7.name: Šćepan Polje → Piva Canyon drive (via Plužine)
7.bestTime: Day 7 (Jun 22) — cross here after the Tara rafting take-out (~14:00). Depart Sarajevo 07:00 → Foča 09:00 → raft start 10:00 → border crossing ~14:00.

7.name: Mratinje Dam (Piva dam)
7.note: Pass ~14:30-15:00 driving south from the border; ~25min roadside photo stop (exposed concrete, no shade — don't linger). Headlights ON for the 56 mostly-unlit Piva-canyon tunnels just south of here.
7.bestTime: Day 7 (Jun 22) — roadside pullover on the Plužine stretch. The 56 tunnels are half the experience; the dam wall is the natural photo stop with the emerald reservoir below.

7.name: Piva Lake (turquoise reservoir swim — on route)
7.note: Self-rent kayak on turquoise Piva Lake at Pluzine — book via the Nature Park Piva info center at the Pluzine entrance (4 self-rent kayaks w/ life jackets, May-Oct 08-20, +382 40 270 069). Free swim too (~18-22C June). Boricje bed is on the lakefront 5min away, so this doubles as the evening/next-morning swim. (Hook beach bar runs GUIDED trips — not self-rent.)
7.bestTime: Day 7 (Jun 22) — natural stop after the Šćepan Polje border crossing and before the 56-tunnel Piva canyon drive to Žabljak. Midday sun = best turquoise color.

7.name: Etno Restoran Sočica (Plužine — lamb ispod sača & Piva-lake terrace)
7.note: Lamb ispod saca + Piva-lake terrace in Pluzine - D7 dinner near the Boricje bed.

8.name: Prutaš (2393m) — Best accessible Durmitor summit
8.note: Trailhead 06:00-06:30; off the ridge by noon (June PM storms). CONDITIONS-DEPENDENT, not default: upper ridge is exposed/scrambly (UIAA-I, some cables) and can hold late-June snow — ASK the Boricje host (D7 night) + check the AM sky. Non-technical fallbacks: Planinica or the Black Lake loop. Pick one summit only.
8.bestTime: Day 8 (Jun 23) — alternative Durmitor plateau walk if skipping Veliki Međed. Start by 07:00; no shelter on the open plateau if storms close in.

8.name: Vražje jezero (Devil's Lake) — swim with a Durmitor backdrop
8.note: Day 8 (Jun 23) afternoon after the Prutas hike — 15km on the Savnik road from Zabljak. Calm evening = best Durmitor reflection. Glacial-cold dip. (Also an option morning of Day 9 en route to Ostrog.)
8.bestTime: Day 8 (Jun 23) afternoon after the Veliki Međed hike — 15 km on the Šavnik road from Žabljak. Calm evening = best Durmitor reflection. Or morning of Day 9 (Jun 24) en route Žabljak → Ostrog.

8.name: Restaurant Or'O (Žabljak — mountain food)
8.note: Post-Durmitor recovery dinner — lamb/trout under sac + kacamak, 4.4★ (2500+ reviews), walk-in, 0-5min from camp. (Ignore older 'Nostalgija is higher-rated' notes — Or'O is the known-good wrecked-group pick.)
8.bestTime: Day 8 (Jun 23) dinner — reliable Žabljak sit-down for kačamak and mountain classics after the Durmitor hike.

8.name: Auto Camp Mlinski Potok (Žabljak)
8.note: Night 8 (Jun 23) — 2nd night of the 2-night Zabljak base (Durmitor hike day). Walk-in OK or email minakamp@gmail.com. 0.6km to Black Lake trailhead.
8.bestTime: Night 7 (Jun 22) — base for the Durmitor hike day (next morning). Walk-in OK or email minakamp@gmail.com. 0.6km walk to Black Lake trailhead.

9.name: Ostrog Monastery
9.note: Day 9 (Jun 24) — depart Zabljak ~06:45-07:00 (drive is a real 2:11/95km mountain road), arrive Ostrog ~09:00 while it's cool and before the pilgrim buses. Open 06:00-17:00 May-Sep, free; cover knees/shoulders, no photos in prayer rooms; park at Lower Monastery. Keep it to 45-60min — the day's drop candidate if tired. Then ~1h45 on to Skadar.
9.bestTime: Day 9 (Jun 24) — depart Žabljak 09:00, arrive ~11:00. Off-peak window is before 09:00 or after 16:00; by 11:00 it's busy but manageable. Closes 17:00 May–Sep.

9.name: Enjoy Skadar Lake kayak base (Rijeka Crnojevića)
9.note: D9 ★ — self-rent (no guide) on the wind-sheltered Crnojevic river bend toward the Pavlova horseshoe/Karuc; calm all day (operator's 'no open lake after 12:00' wind rule doesn't apply to the channel). Reserve 1-2 days ahead via Enjoy Skadar Lake / WhatsApp; single EUR7/h or EUR25/day, double EUR10/h or EUR35/day + EUR5pp NP fee.
9.bestTime: Morning — before noon to avoid lake winds. Perfect combo: kayak Karuč + lunch at Stari Most.

9.name: Rijeka Crnojevića — Danilo's Bridge swim + kayak village
9.note: Easy warm river swim at Danilo's Bridge in the same village as the kayak + Mostina — fills the post-paddle gap, zero driving.

9.name: Konoba Stari Most (Rijeka Crnojevića)
9.note: D9 special meal — Konoba Stari Most, 50m from the kayak launch in Rijeka Crnojevica (Lonely Planet's MNE pick). ~EUR13.50 full 3-course, cash, walk-in. Ask for the fish GRILLED (can arrive deep-fried).
9.bestTime: Lunch or early dinner; pairs with a kayak from Enjoy Skadar Lake (300m away) + Karuč detour

9.name: Pavlova Strana viewpoint (Skadar Lake)
9.note: Day 9 (Jun 24) late afternoon ~17:00-18:00 (day ends 18:30 at the Rvasi bed). Drive the WIDER approach road, not the rough forest track. Sequence: Ostrog morning -> kayak/swim midday -> Mostina lunch -> Pavlova Strana -> 15min to Rvasi.
9.bestTime: Day 9 (Jun 24) late afternoon — sunset ~20:22. Drive the wider approach road (not the forest track). Sequence: kayak morning → Virpazar fish lunch → Pavlova Strana golden hour.

10.name: SUP self-rent on Skadar (Virpazar — Boat Milica all-day SUP)
10.note: D10 OPTIONAL morning paddle (~09:00, flat water before afternoon lake wind) — Boat Milica +382 69 358 118, SAY 'self-guided' (listings default to guided), NP ticket EUR5pp. Demoted to an option so D10 leads on islands+winery (differentiates from D9's river kayak); do the SUP OR the Murici/Beska day-trip, not both.

10.name: Murići → Beška island self-swim / €20 boat-taxi (Skadar south shore)
10.note: D10 ★ (the islands lead) — far-south Skadar (~1.5h single-lane serpentine each way; leave Rvasi by ~08:30 to drive it before midday heat). EUR20 boat-taxi to Beska island monasteries + swim off the boat (open-water swim-across is deceptively long, strong swimmers only). Pick THIS day-trip OR the Virpazar SUP/winery cluster — not both.

10.name: Pješačac beach (Skadar Lake's secret sandy cove)
10.note: D10 midday warm-swim — shade-backed cove, water bath-warm in June, ideal heat-of-day water between the morning paddle and the sunset winery.

10.name: Vinarija Mašanović (Virpazar — the Skadar winery stop)
10.note: Day 10 (Jun 25) late afternoon/sunset (~18:00) — book +382 68 509 541 / vinarijamasanovic@yahoo.com the day BEFORE; CASH ONLY. Sequence: morning SUP/swim near Virpazar -> midday warm swim (Pjesacac/Murici) -> winery sunset -> back to Rvasi.
10.bestTime: Day 9 (Jun 24) afternoon — book +382 68 509 541 or vinarijamasanovic@yahoo.com the day before. Bring cash. Sequence: kayak morning → fish lunch → winery → Pavlova Strana golden hour.

11.name: Tandem Paragliding Brajići → Bečići (GO2FLY / Budva)
11.note: Book GO2FLY ahead; they fly when conditions suit (AM often smoother, late-PM better light). Do it while in the Budva area before heading N to Kotor.

11.name: Sveti Nikola Island ("Hawaii") Cliff Jumping (Budva)
11.note: Midday water — shuttle boat ~12:30-15:00 from Budva Marina/Slovenska (~EUR5-7 RT, frequent in season). Scout each ledge for depth before jumping. Keep it early-afternoon so the ~17:00 fortress climb stays free; a drop-if-tired candidate.

11.name: Budva Old Town
11.note: Budva Old Town — quick stop (you base at Stoliv + do the Kotor bar night, not Budva nightlife). ⚠ DRIVE BUFFER: summer-2026 Vrmac-tunnel + Tivat-Jaz roadworks can triple Budva->Kotor to 60-90min — leave Budva by ~15:00 to hold the ~17:00 fortress sunset; if the Vrmac tunnel shows dark-red, take the Trojica turn-off (switchbacks, ~20min faster).
11.bestTime: Day 11 (Jun 26) — morning stop en route Sveti Stefan → Kotor; quick beach swim before the bay. Avoid midday old town — crowds peak 10:00–16:00. Sparta club open 23:00+ (only if basing nearby).

11.name: Bay of Kotor self-guided kayak (Go Go Gaga)
11.note: FLEX slot — Go Go Gaga / Dobrota self-rent, licence-free, ~EUR10-15/h. Grab it ~15:30-17:00 (golden hour) before the fortress, OR drop it if the Budva morning runs long. Self-rent (no guide), Kotor->Perast-direction paddle + swim.
11.bestTime: dawn, before the boats start at 09:00

11.name: Kotor Old Town + San Giovanni Fortress hike
11.note: Fortress climb (1350 steps) ~17:00 = cooler + golden light; crest the first rampart for the 20:26 sunset. EUR15pp fee applies 08:00-20:00 but the trail is open 24h — NO lock-in risk on an evening climb. Bring water + proper shoes (slippery). The day's anchor.
11.bestTime: Day 11 (Jun 26) — start the 1,200-step fortress climb at 07:30 (free before 08:00, cruise tourists arrive ~09:30). Combine with Perast + Lovćen mausoleum same day.

11.name: BBQ Tanjga (Kotor — legendary cheap grill)
11.note: Legendary cheap grill (EUR4.50-5/plate, XXL mix ~EUR35/2), cash only — POST-fortress dinner, 5min from the gate, perfect after 1,350 steps. An evening visit after the ~20:00 sunset climb works; arrive before 12:00 or after ~14:00 only if going earlier.
11.bestTime: Day 11 (Jun 26) lunch after the Kotor fortress — arrive before 12:00 or after 14:00. Cash only.

11.name: Kotor Old-Town Bars (Bokun, Letrika, Bandiera)
11.note: Relaxed Kotor old-town bar night (Bokun, Letrika, Bandiera) — no dress code, walkable, ~10-15min taxi/water-taxi back to Stoliv camp.

11.name: Camping Mimoza (Donji Stoliv, Kotor Bay)
11.note: Reserve AHEAD now — ~12 pitches, one of the most booked in the bay in June. Waterfront Donji Stoliv, hot showers, ~EUR30-40 for 4 cash. ~12min by car/water-taxi to Kotor old town for the bar night.
11.bestTime: June: very small (≈12 pitches) and 'one of the most booked' — reserve ahead. Top forest pitches are the shaded tent spots.

12.name: Cavtat self-drive boat rental — no licence/skipper (Mario Milicic)
12.note: D12 ★ self-drive boat — KEEP on D12: launches from Cavtat port (same SE side as the Mlini base + Pasjaca, zero net driving), licence-free (<=5hp/500m-from-shore), ~EUR85/half-day for 4 (2026 price, was EUR60; ~EUR15-21pp). Calm Konavle coast + the 3 reserve islets (Mrkan/Bobara/Supetar) for anchor-swim-snorkel. Cannot legally reach Lokrum/Elaphiti — those need a licence or a Zaton-launched boat (wrong side for D12).

12.name: Cavtat Rat peninsula swim & snorkel coves (Kamen Mali, Ključice, Žal)
12.note: Free swim platforms & clear coves 1.5km from Cilipi airport — the fix for the D3 airport dead-window (hot afternoon water while waiting for the 17:20 landing), and a swim stop on D12. No backtrack, no cost.

12.name: Camping Kate (Mlini, near Dubrovnik)
12.note: Last campsite night before the Jun-28 flight — reserve ahead + arrive before ~14:00 reception (June peak). info@campingkate.com / +385 20 487 006. ~25min to Dubrovnik Old Town.
12.bestTime: Book ahead: info@campingkate.com or +385 20 487 006 (Jun, peak). Arrive before 14:00. Night 12 (Jun 27) — the Dubrovnik-area overnight, ~25 min from the old town.

13.name: Sveti Jakov beach (Dubrovnik)
13.note: Day 13 (Jun 28) early morning — swim/snorkel 08:00-09:30 before the 10:00 kayak; quiet local beach with the best Old-Town view. A quick pre-kayak filler, skip if tight.

13.name: Dubrovnik Sea Kayaking — Walls & Lokrum
13.note: D13 morning ★ — book the 10:00 departure (back ~13:00), same-day via X-Adventure Dubrovnik or by 16:00 the day before. NOT the sunset tour — the day ends at the airport, so the afternoon stays as flight buffer. Sea kayak under the Dubrovnik walls + Lokrum = a fitting finale.
13.bestTime: Day 4 (Jun 19) — book same-day via X-Adventure Dubrovnik. Sunset tour starts ~19:00; wine + walls glowing at dusk. Book by 16:00.

13.name: Bellevue (Miramare) Beach Cliff Jumping (Dubrovnik)
13.note: D13 SKIP-CANDIDATE — a third water item on a water-led flight-out day; tagged half-day, it competes with the 10:00 kayak. Keep it only as a short jump-and-swim if the morning runs ahead; otherwise drop so the 18:00 airport-leave is never in doubt.

13.name: Dubrovnik Old Town
13.note: Day 13 Old Town (NOT the airport day's pickup). City walls EUR40pp (2026, incl. Lovrijenac); the EUR40 Dubrovnik Pass = same price + museums + 24h bus (better value if you want more). OPTION not default — go EARLY (08:00, before the cruise crowds) on this Jun28 cruise day, and protect the 18:00 Old-Town leave for the 20:40 flight.
13.bestTime: Day 12 (Jun 27 Saturday) — walls open 06:30 (€35pp); finish before cruise ships ~10:00. Car drop airport Jun 28 by 19:15 (Ref D013947246).

13.name: Dubrovnik Airport (Čilipi) — car drop & fly Jun 28
13.note: HARD anchor — FLIGHT FR9756 20:40 -> VIE 22:05 (check-in closes ~20:00; car drop ~19:15, Ref D013947246; allow 45min for fuel + return). Jun 28 is a LIKELY cruise day in Dubrovnik — Old Town->Cilipi can run 45-60min, NOT 25. LEAVE the Old Town by ~18:00 no matter what.
13.bestTime: Day 13 (Jun 28) — car drop by 19:15 at latest to have 45 min for fuel+return before check-in closes. Flight FR9756 20:40→VIE 22:05. Full day usable up to ~18:30.
